title: Offline rank-envelope audit stress test
status: Specified before running this experiment; not externally preregistered
controls: All methods use the same fixed pools and budget grid.
Every replicate uses common random uniforms and prompt indices across proposals, and prefix-coupled draw counts; comparisons are paired.
Every requested draw count is analyzed at a fixed horizon, not a data-dependent stop.
The 95% band covers the nine risk budgets for one method/scenario/horizon. It is not a simultaneous guarantee across every experiment setting.
Unique labels are cost measurements only; we do not stop on a unique-label budget.
Naive normal intervals are a deliberately invalid reference diagnostic, not a proposed safe method.
No outputs are from a real LLM; high rank means higher constructed proxy score.
